intent.description: Use this Agent Skill when a user provides an existing rendered MP4 or concept-motion explainer video and asks for a post-render audit, frame-based review, subtitle check, visual-quality review, spatial-continuity review, or audio-sync review. It checks visual expression, spatial continuity, temporal alignment, subtitles, and delivery integrity, then produces evidence-linked findings and a repair handoff. Trigger on requests such as “审查这个解说视频成片”“检查字幕和音画同步”“逐帧找出动效问题”。Exclude script-only rewriting, new video production, existing-footage editing, reference-video study, and generic media recommendations; route production to `script-to-explainer-video` and reference study to the repository's reference-study Skill.
intent.job_to_be_done: 对已经渲染的口播或概念动效视频建立可复现的证据链，审查视觉表达、空间连续、时序对齐、字幕可读性和技术完整性，并输出修复交接包。
inputs: 已渲染 MP4 或可读取的成片视频
冻结文稿、segments.json、timeline.json、字幕和音频（可选但会影响证据完整度）
制作要求、平台规格和重点关注项（可选）
outputs: review-report.json 和 Markdown 问题摘要
带时间戳、证据、严重级、置信度和修复建议的 finding 清单
生产修复、整片重渲染和复审交接条件
exclusions: 参考视频学习和镜头拆解
没有成片输入的通用媒体建议

should_trigger: 审查这个概念动效视频成片，输出带时间戳的问题清单
检查这个 MP4 的字幕、音画同步、转场和空间连贯性
根据 timeline.json 逐帧复核成片，找出 major 和 blocker 问题
把视频审查结果整理成 review-report.json，再交给生产 Skill 修复
should_not_trigger: 只改写这篇文章的口播文案，不审查视频
给已有实拍素材只做字幕
把这份文案制作成概念动效视频
做参考视频分析，拆解镜头和剪辑节奏
near_neighbor: 分析这个 MP4 的内容并写一份主题摘要
把一段已有实拍素材剪成带字幕的短视频
为一个新主题设计概念动效视频方案

router_rules: Trigger when an existing MP4 or rendered explainer video needs a post-render audit, quality review, subtitle review, frame review, or audio-sync review.
Use the four review dimensions and return evidence-linked findings; a report is the primary deliverable.
Route reference-video learning, shot breakdown, and editing-grammar extraction to the repository's reference-study Skill.
Exclude script-only rewriting, caption-only generation without a video review, existing-footage editing, and generic media advice.
compact_workflow: Inventory the MP4, available frozen sources, requirements, and tool availability.
Generate a deterministic sampling plan; use quick, standard, or dense review based on duration and motion density.
Run structural preflight for media metadata, audio presence, subtitle coverage, timeline alignment, and render integrity.
Review visual expression, spatial continuity, temporal alignment, and subtitle readability against the same evidence bundle.
Record findings with timestamps, evidence references, severity, confidence, and repair scope.
Return one complete report; group fixable source defects into a repair handoff and request a new full render for re-review.
gate_ladder: **Input gate**: the MP4 is readable and the review basis is recorded; missing artifacts receive an evidence label.
**Media gate**: duration, frame rate, dimensions, stream presence, and audio state are recorded.
**Evidence gate**: every finding points to a timestamp, frame, audio window, subtitle cue, or source artifact.
**Dimension gate**: all four dimensions are reviewed or explicitly marked `missing_evidence`.
**Triage gate**: each finding has severity, confidence, repair scope, and pass/warn/fail status.
**Handoff gate**: source defects point back to the production Skill; a repaired source requires full rerender and a new report.
output_contract: `review-report.json` and the human-readable report use the same finding IDs, timestamps, severity, status, and evidence references.
Status values are `pass`, `warn`, `fail`, and `missing_evidence`; severity values are `blocker`, `major`, `minor`, and `note`.
A finding without a concrete evidence reference remains a hypothesis and keeps that label until evidence is attached.
A complete pass requires media preflight, four dimension results, and a recorded output/review evidence boundary.
Provider playback, human perception, and external render evidence remain `missing_evidence` until observed.

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow read-only source and catalog review; require explicit user input for external writes

permissions.network: optional source and provider metadata lookup only
permissions.file_write: review project directory and report artifacts only when requested
permissions.subprocess: ffprobe, FFmpeg, bundled sampling/report validators, and configured media tools
permissions.interactive: only for missing review basis, hard blockers, or user acceptance of warnings

scaffold: frontmatter has name, description, trigger scope, and explicit exclusions
README has natural-language triggers and a validation hook
review input/output and evidence boundary are stated
production: four review dimensions and technical preflight are present
sampling presets and evidence references are deterministic
trigger cases cover positive, negative, and near-neighbor requests
repair handoff and full-rerender loop are explicit
runtime, playback, and human evidence claims are labeled
library: Skill IR and prior-art report are present
platform and degradation metadata are present
review cadence and owner are declared
governed: rollback, trust, secret, and publication boundaries are present

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
